d:
Shadiyon ke mausam men sone ki kharidari barh rahi hai, lekin holmarking ki nigrani par saval uthe hain. midiya men aaee ek draft CAG riport ke mutabiq, biaaeees ne 2020-21 se 2024-25 ke bich 83 fisdi se zyada rajistard jvelars ka salana inspekshan nahin kiya. vahin, sone men reniyam nam ki bhari dhatu milane aur janch men iske pakar men na aane ke dave bhi samne aae hain. reniyam kya hai, is milavat ko lekar jankar kya kahte hain aur sona kharidte samay uski shuddhata ki janch kaise karen?
